# wire-full-parties: a full bot card and a full duel both arrive (POK-330 #11).
#
# The ROM's reassembly caps predated the item tails (POK-237): a TRAINER could hold 610
# bytes and a DUEL 1204, while the page packs a six-mon card with a seven-letter name and
# four items to 619 and every 6v6 duel to at least 1206. BrWire_Assemble drops a message
# over its cap without a word, so the late-game bot's card never staged -- the CHALLENGE
# behind it then opened a link battle with a bot, which the watchdog forfeited -- and
# every 6v6 duel went to the seeded resolver instead of a fight. The caps are now read
# off the full layout (BR_CAP_*, tools/br/wire-table.txt), and web/src/net/caps.test.ts
# packs the page's largest instance of each message against them.
wait 30
pokebytes gBrMailbox+0x2018 81 00 00 09 05 00 08 00 BD BB C7 FF
wait 400
poke u8 gBrMatch 2
# TRAINER: seat 31, "WALLACE", six level 5 mons (TREECKO..BLAZIKEN, POUND), and four items
# -- POTION, X ATTACK, SUPER POTION, FULL HEAL. 619 bytes, eleven slots.
pokebytes gDecompressionBuffer 1F 07 D1 BB C6 C6 BB BD BF 06 15 01 05 13 00 13 00 00 01 00 23 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00

pokebytes gDecompressionBuffer+600 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 04 0D 00 4B 00 16 00 17 00
mailsend gBrMailbox 23 gDecompressionBuffer 619
# Building six mons is several frames of CreateMon: the drain is stalled until it is done.
wait 60
expect u16 gBrMailbox+0x0E 11
# staged: seat 31, all six, the name, and all four items off the tail
expect u8 gBrBotFight 1
expect u8 gBrBotFight+1 31
expect u8 gBrBotFight+3 6
expect u8 gBrBotFight+4 0xD1
expect u8 gBrBotFight+10 0xBF
expect u8 gBrBotFight+0xC 4
expect u16 gBrBotFight+0xE 0x0D
expect u16 gBrBotFight+0x14 0x17
